title: Dungeon Running for Noobs
description: Dungeon Running for Noobs — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Liza Beth

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Staying in Dew Valley, buy Dungeon Running for Noobs from Samford the Hermit and return with it to Liza Beth.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Liza Beth

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Another Favor

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Staying in Dew Valley, buy Dungeon Running for Noobs from Samford the Hermit and return with it to Liza Beth.

Offer:

Ohmygosh, this queue is totally taking forever! My name is Liza Beth. I'm here because I want to be an apprentice librarian, but the queue is taking so very long and I don't know why!

Why are you here? ...Not sure? That's totally odd, standing in the queue but not knowing why. But, that's okay, we can still be friends--you and me, bestest friends forever!

Say, since we're bestest friends and all, I was hoping you would help me. There's a shopkeeper nearby with a book I'd like to read, but I'm totally afraid to lose my place in line. *Totally*. If you buy Dungeon Running for Noobs from Samford the Hermit for me, I'll totally hold your place in the help queue.

Tip: Merchant menus may have several tabs at the top. For this task, look for the Quest Items tab.

Turn-in:

That's totally the book I've been wanting to read! I totally owe you one!

Objectives:

  • Dungeon Running For Noobs ×1

Level range: 1–5
